rule: Event engine: a window is active when start < now < end and (now - start) mod occurence is under length (GameEventMgr.cpp 46-84). NextCheck sleeps the world timer to the next boundary, capped at a day (World.cpp 1324). Internal events (state 5) are started and stopped by scripts and are not turned off by the timer. Scourge siege: a zone is won when its camp count is zero and its slot time has passed (WorldState.cpp 1823); wins feed milestone events at 50, 100 and 150 (WorldState.cpp 1576-1600). Roamer: follow a random threat-list player without attacking for 15 to 30 s, else wander 25 yd every 2.5 s; pull the current victim back when it is past 50 yd, checked every 0.5 s (boss_emerald_dragons.cpp 145-218). Wintergrasp: 30 min battle, 150 min quiet, invite at 15 min left, all three south towers down cut 10 min from the battle clock (BattlefieldWG.cpp 63-68, 1132-1137). Capture: each 1 s tick moves value by (allies minus horde) x elapsed x rate, clamped by max step (OutdoorPvP.cpp 353-387).
keep: window formula with start, end, occurence and length; NextCheck-style sleep to the next boundary

look_test: On a 375-wide phone: one siege zone with a storm grade change, a Herald beacon, three camps with a visible counter and a 2-minute slot timer. Compare counter-and-timer win against timer-only win. Second: one roamer on a 25-yard leash that follows a random player for 15 s and pulls its victim back past 50 yards. Dom judges whether the pull-back reads as a fair tether or a yank.
